character.journeyLede: What happens to this person, title by title.
characters.lede: Who these people are, where they come from, and how they become what they become. Written for someone meeting them for the first time.
characters.title: Characters
collections.lede: The named variants of a thing, explained one by one. The armours, the suits, the forms, the stones. Things people go looking for after a film and rarely find explained in one place.
collections.title: Collections

glossary.advanced: Worth knowing once you are in
glossary.advancedHelp: Terms that turn up later, and that reward knowing before they do.
glossary.coreHelp: The handful of terms that make everything else readable.
glossary.lede: The words this material uses constantly and rarely stops to explain. If a film assumed you knew one of these, the entry is here.
glossary.title: Glossary
home.allOfLede: Every title, grouped by the era it belongs to. Each era has its own colour, and it is the same colour wherever that title appears on the site.
home.runStartLede: Release order, which is the order these were built to be understood in. Mark them as you go.
i18n.fallbackNotice: This page has not been translated into {language} yet, so you are reading the English version.
map.lede: Each row is one story, and time runs left to right. A line between two titles means the first sets up the second. The separate universes sit below the divider because they are a different story, not a later part of this one.
map.title: The map of connections
phases.empty: Nothing from this phase is in the catalogue yet.
phases.lede: Marvel Studios groups its releases into numbered blocks, the way a long series is divided into seasons. Useful for knowing where you are, misleading as a place to start.
phases.title: Phases
saga.foxNote: A separate continuity, made by another studio for twenty years.
saga.infinityNote: Phases one to three. The run that ends with Endgame.
saga.multiverseNote: Phases four to six. Where the single timeline breaks.
saga.sonyNote: Spider-Man and the films built around him, in their own continuities.
saga.unboundNote: Marvel films that belong to no shared story. Included, and marked.
search.kind.title: Title
search.lede: Everything on the site in one list: films and series, collections and the things in them, glossary terms, guides. Start typing.
search.title: Search
theme.label: Theme
timeline.lede: Every film and series, in the order they came out or the order the story happens. Choose how much you want to see, and mark what you have watched.
timeline.searchPlaceholder: Filter by title, era or franchise
timeline.separateHelp: The films made by other studios, and anything set outside the main continuity. They are kept apart because they are a different story, not a later part of this one.
timeline.title: Timeline
universes.continuity.unbound: Not part of any shared story
universes.lede: Not one story but several, made by different companies under separate licences, which is why some of these characters spent twenty years unable to meet.
universes.title: Universes
watchOrder.byChronologyHelp: Follows the order events happen in the story.
watchOrder.byReleaseHelp: Follows the order things actually came out. Best for a first watch.
watchOrder.tier.completeHelp: Adds shorts, older television, and the Fox and Sony films.
watchOrder.tier.essentialHelp: Feature films only. No series, no specials.
watchOrder.tier.extendedHelp: Adds the series that carry the main story forward.
watched.exportHelp: Download a small file with what you have marked, so you can carry it to another browser or device.
watched.resetConfirm: This clears everything you have marked in this browser. It cannot be undone.
watched.storageNotice: Your progress is saved in this browser only. It is never sent anywhere.
watched.storageUnavailable: This browser is not letting the page save anything, so your progress will not be kept.
